name: TECK RES LTD. B SUB.VTG
summary: Teck Resources Limited is a diversified resource company committed to responsible mining and mineral development with major business units focused on copper, zinc, and energy. Headquartered in Vancouver, Canada, Teck is a major producer of steelmaking coal and also produces lead, silver, and various specialty metals, serving customers worldwide. Teck operates in North America, South America and Europe.
